generate.initial_sparql:
PREFIX wm: <https://wealth.example.org/ontology/>
PREFIX kg: <https://wealth.example.org/kg/>
PREFIX wmmeta: <https://wealth.example.org/metadata/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX schema1: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?investorId ?investorName
WHERE {
  ?inv a wm:Investor .
  ?inv wm:segment ?segment .
  FILTER(LCASE(STR(?segment)) = "conservative") .
  OPTIONAL { ?inv wm:investorId ?investorId . }
  OPTIONAL { ?inv wm:investorName ?investorName . }
  ?inv wm:hasPortfolioHealth ?ph .
  ?ph wm:riskScore ?riskScore .
  ?ph wm:liquidityScore ?liqScore .
  FILTER(xsd:decimal(?riskScore) > 80) .
  FILTER(xsd:decimal(?liqScore) < 20) .
}

PREFIX wm: <https://wealth.example.org/ontology/>

SELECT DISTINCT ?investor ?name

  FILTER(LCASE(STR(?rt)) = "conservative") .
  OPTIONAL { ?investor rdfs:label ?name . }
  ?investor wm:hasPortfolioHealth ?ph .
  ?ph wm:riskScore ?riskScore .
  ?ph wm:liquidityScore ?liqScore .
  FILTER(xsd:decimal(?riskScore) > 80) .
  FILTER(xsd:decimal(?liqScore) < 20) .
}
